goal: Stop recording blocks as safely saved when writing block or undo data to disk fails
Prevent state and index corruption when disk flushes fail, especially with separate block storage
agreement: Broad support for preventing corruption and closing an invariant gap on flush failure (mzumsande, arejula27)
Verified by local testing and confirming test failure without the fix (optout21, arejula27)
Open question on whether flushing should succeed on retry after shutdown was requested (arejula27)

categories.name: validation
why: P1 because it prevents disk corruption and chainstate desync when block or undo file flushes fail
Stops metadata and coins database writes from committing blocks whose data was not made durable
